items.title: Outlook Cut Might Change The Case For Investing In DraftKings Stock (DKNG)
items.summary: DraftKings cut its 2026 outlook, now guiding to a loss after raising spending on its prediction markets unit and reporting a larger Q3 operating loss despite growth in sportsbook and iGaming net revenue. The heavier bet on prediction markets exposes DraftKings to both tougher competition from Coinbase and others and to legal questions that could affect planned future cash flows. items.title: Competition Started In 24/7 Trading: Andrew Cuomo
items.summary: Andrew Cuomo, former governor of New York and co-chair of OKXICE, joins Scarlet Fu and Tim Stenovec on "Bloomberg Crypto." They discuss OKXICE's launch of the tokenized securities venue from the joint venture between OKX and the Intercontinental Exchange. The platform has over 100 assets available in a phased rollout for round-the-clock trading.
